items.example: It's a vicious circle: no job, no money, no job.
items.exampleTr: Kısır döngü: iş yok, para yok, iş yok.
items.simple: A bad thing makes another bad thing, and then it starts again.

items.example: That's a sweeping generalisation, and it isn't fair.
items.exampleTr: Bu toptan bir genelleme ve adil değil.
items.simple: Saying something is true for everyone or everything, when it is not.

items.example: The internet here is painfully slow.
items.exampleTr: Buranın interneti çileden çıkaracak kadar yavaş.
items.simple: So slow that it makes you feel bad waiting.

items.example: Those habits are deeply ingrained.
items.exampleTr: O alışkanlıklar çok kökleşmiş.
items.simple: Something stays in you for a long time and is very hard to change.

items.example: The two brothers have a fierce rivalry.
items.exampleTr: İki kardeşin arasında amansız bir rekabet var.
items.simple: Two people or teams want to beat each other very, very much.

items.example: He was blissfully unaware of the trouble coming.
items.exampleTr: Gelmekte olan beladan mutlu mutlu habersizdi.
items.simple: You do not know about a problem, so you feel happy.

items.example: He has a vested interest in the company doing well.
items.exampleTr: Şirketin iyi gitmesinde kişisel bir çıkarı var.
items.simple: A strong reason to want something, because it helps you.

items.example: The new job has a steep learning curve.
items.exampleTr: Yeni işin başlangıcı çok zorlu.
items.simple: At the start, you have to learn many hard things very fast.

items.example: Winning like that felt like a hollow victory.
items.exampleTr: Öyle kazanmak içi boş bir zafer gibi geldi.
items.simple: You win, but it does not make you feel happy.

items.example: Money is a recurring theme in our arguments.
items.exampleTr: Para, tartışmalarımızda tekrar eden bir konu.
items.simple: Something that keeps coming back again and again.

items.example: She's fiercely independent and hates asking for help.
items.exampleTr: Çok bağımsız ruhlu ve yardım istemekten nefret ediyor.
items.simple: Wanting to do everything alone, very strongly.

items.example: The whole design is fundamentally flawed.
items.exampleTr: Bütün tasarım temelden kusurlu.
items.simple: The main idea has a problem, so the whole thing is wrong.

items.example: Your reaction is perfectly understandable.
items.exampleTr: Tepkin gayet anlaşılır.
items.simple: It makes complete sense, so nobody is angry about it.

items.example: The training was woefully inadequate.
items.exampleTr: Eğitim acınacak derecede yetersizdi.
items.simple: Much, much too little, and that is very sad.

items.example: There was a glaring mistake in the first line.
items.exampleTr: İlk satırda göze batan bir hata vardı.
items.simple: A mistake that is so big that everyone can see it.

items.example: Finishing by Friday is a tall order.
items.exampleTr: Cumaya kadar bitirmek çok zor bir istek.
items.simple: Something that is very hard to do.

items.example: Social media is a double-edged sword.
items.exampleTr: Sosyal medya iki ucu keskin bir kılıç.
items.simple: Something that is good in one way and bad in another way.

items.example: Kids are remarkably resilient.
items.exampleTr: Çocuklar şaşırtıcı derecede dirençlidir.
items.simple: Able to get better quickly after something bad happens.

items.example: I think he has a hidden agenda.
items.exampleTr: Bence gizli bir amacı var.
items.simple: A secret reason someone has for doing something.

items.example: I'm acutely aware that time is running out.
items.exampleTr: Zamanın tükendiğinin çok iyi farkındayım.
items.simple: You notice something very strongly, and you cannot forget it.

items.example: There's a fine line between brave and stupid.
items.exampleTr: Cesaret ile aptallık arasında ince bir çizgi var.
items.simple: Two things are almost the same, and it is easy to mix them up.

items.example: The report was painstakingly detailed.
items.exampleTr: Rapor titizlikle ayrıntılıydı.
items.simple: Written with great care, with every small part included.

items.example: The idea got a lukewarm response.
items.exampleTr: Fikir soğuk karşılandı.
items.simple: People are not excited. They do not love it or hate it.

items.example: I give that dog a wide berth.
items.exampleTr: O köpekten uzak dururum.
items.simple: Staying far away from someone or something on purpose.
